messages:
sophia: Heads up — nightly CI smallbatch perf regressed after the last merge. p99 jumped ~3x. Dashboard: https://perf.redwood.ai/compare/3051. Looks like a KV cache eviction spike. Anyone else seeing this?

perf-bot: nightly-smallbatch: baseline p99=82ms -> HEAD p99=221ms (+170ms, x2.7). Regression window: commit range 0f9a2b3..HEAD. Profile bundle: https://perf.redwood.ai/bundles/3051.

mike: that was my scheduler tweak (small_seq_weight change) that merged earlier today. aimed to improve throughput by favoring short-seq packing. didn't expect kv churn. i'll bisect locally.

sophia: please run the perf script on scale1, steps in infra/run_perf.sh — want numbers and flamegraph.

mike: running now. command i'm using:
```
./scripts/run_perf --suite smallbatch --repeats 40 --env scale=scale1
```

mike: early bisect points at prefetch/selector interaction. selector now prefers tighter tiles which increases prefetch pressure -> more KV evictions.

marie: saw similar traces in prod tests this morning. KV eviction calls spike right after that commit, flame shows `kv_cache::evict_if_needed` dominating wall time.

kevin: profiler top lines (hotspot):
```
25.4%  memcpy_async
18.7%  prefetch_dispatch
14.9%  kv_cache::evict_if_needed
10.3%  matmul_kernel
```

kevin: memcopies up ~3x, likely from more aggressive prefetching of shards that are immediately evicted.

mike: bisect pinned to commit 0f9a2b3 — commit message: "scheduler: increase small_seq_weight to favor short sequences (reduce fragmentation)". repro with a skewed seq_len workload.

marie: :thumbsup: recommend revert — this is a rollout blocker for smallbatch latency.

sophia: agree. we can't ship this regression. mike, can you open a revert PR and run CI?

mike: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/7512 (revert 0f9a2b3). triggering CI now.

perf-bot: quick CI snapshot for PR#7512: p99=86ms (baseline-equivalent). diff: -135ms p99 vs HEAD.

deploy-bot: staging rollout paused: tag=regression-detected. no further rollout until PR lands or manual override.

kevin: we should add a regression test that uses a skewed seq_len distribution and verifies KV eviction under threshold. I'll file a ticket.

marie: filed TICKET-3842: "add skewed-smallbatch regression + KV eviction monitor" with repro steps and perf script.

sophia: follow-ups: (1) revert to unblock rollout, (2) add CI regression test, (3) design a scheduler change that is KV-aware (couple scheduler weight + prefetch heuristics). assigning to eng-runtime perf epic.

mike: will open RFC for scheduler rewrite with KV-sensitivity and test vectors, and add telemetry counters for evict_rate per shard.

sophia: thanks all. keeping this thread as the rollback record. :white_check_mark:
